customer.displayName: Heatilator Icon 60 with Hargrove Woodland Timber log set
customer.shortDescription: An open-face wood fireplace shown with a Hargrove gas log set drop-in — a teaching display for "convert wood to gas logs" customers.
bestFor: Customer with existing open-face wood fireplace exploring gas-log retrofit

rep.verificationNotes: For a gas-log retrofit, first determine masonry vs prefab, then get all dimensions (front W/H/D, rear W, hearth context), then confirm if gas is already present and where the line enters.
rep.liamVoiceCallback: Hargrove — we've been dealing with them for two decades. Their Woodland Timbers series is the number one best looking log set I have ever seen — and I've been to the HBBA show.
rep.crossSellNotes: If customer wants a gas-only insert instead of log set retrofit, walk to positions 21-30 (gas insert anchors). If wanting a new wood fireplace, position 18 (Supreme Astra 38) or position 20 (FPX 44 Elite).
rep.displayCallback: Position 14 — wood + log set teaching display. Compare with position 15 (Heatilator Birmingham 42B + Hargrove Pinnacle + Ironhaus door).
rep.salesNotes: Teaching display, not a single-SKU sale. Use this to walk a customer through the wood-to-gas-logs decision. The Icon 60 is the open-face wood box; the Hargrove Woodland Timbers set is the gas-log drop-in shown inside it. Realism + heat (radiant ceramic fiber) story.

internal.marginNotes: Gas log sets are accessory-tier margin; full retrofit (line work, install) adds labor revenue.
internal.recommendableStatusReason: Active teaching display; closes the wood-to-gas-logs path. Hargrove is Benson's primary gas log supplier (Real Fyre carried but not displayed).

brochureRefs.note: Look in vented_gas_logs.log_set_families[family_name=Woodland Timbers]. Candidate SKU WTS2418RG (24", radiant heat, $859 dealer) per drew_notable flag.
Icon series in Heatilator legacy/wood line.
